direction: User requests darker watercolor exploration; prior06-watercolour marked MIX with no trait ratings.

assets.name: Rain
assets.observations: Fixed scene/camera/gate/three people preserved. Cold wet washes and dark-blue-gray mood visible; warm practical light retained. Fine mechanical modeling persists, so this is a detailed watercolor treatment rather than the loose simplified illustration requested.
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: 16:9 landscape concept-art image for an RPG style exploration.
Input image 1 is the exact composition and topology reference. Input image 2 is a parent watercolor experiment, useful for the medium only, NOT its bright colors. We want substantially more authentic painterly watercolor than image 2.
Primary request: Completely repaint image 1 by hand in REAL TRANSLUCENT WATERCOLOR on cold-pressed paper. Not a filter laid over a 3D render. Reduce microdetail by at least half and replace smooth modeled surfaces with pigment blooms, staining puddles, wet-on-wet diffuse edges, granulation, selective drybrush and sparse ink architectural contours. Visible paper tooth through the washes. Large planes of exposed but dimly tinted paper can indicate traversable ground. Small people clear silhouettes. Preserve the entire scene camera, framing, underlying architecture, main objects and exact locations.
Fixed invariants: Elevated overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel projection, consistent character scale, continuous grounded station playfield. No horizon, no camera lens perspective, no floating diorama, no depth-of-field. Left upper gallery and center-left stair; upper-left workbench and repairer; lower-left seated person on bench with patterned cushion and tiny tea/plant table; huge center pier with dispenser and relay; protagonist immediately before CLOSED mid-right gate; freight rails/cranes/containers right. Exactly THREE people in the same poses and positions. Keep all rails, pillar outlines and main objects recognizable, simplify tiny bolts and industrial texture into painted marks. Do not add objects, creatures, people or scenery. No text/UI/watermark, tiny signs become original pictograms. Darker mood with legible walking paths and figures, no gratuitous horror.
Variant: RAIN / cold slate watercolor refinement.
Palette: Paynes gray, slate blue, muted cold blue-gray, desaturated olive-black, dirty gray paper, very small subdued warm ochre at existing workbench lamp and existing fixtures.
Lighting and mood: rainy overcast late-day daylight, oppressive quiet civic space. Low ambient grey light, wet concrete suggested by diffuse pooled watercolor stains and a few broken pale gray reflections, no bright sun. Darker and far less pastel than reference2. Ink outlines sparse and delicate, pigment granulation and feathered wet-on-wet blooms dominate. White paper appears only as soft grey-tinted highlights, not a bright white overall backdrop. Broad dark washes on freight equipment and architecture, gently lighter walking ground.

assets.name: Midnight
assets.observations: Scene/camera/gate/three people preserved. Indigo architecture with strong existing amber light pools reads darker than round01 watercolor. Watercolor blooms visible across floor/pillars, but detailed modeled machines persist; medium shift remains restrained despite explicit simplification instructions.

Label accurately as detailed ink-and-wash hybrid.

Imagine an expressive concept painter documenting this station with a big wet mop brush and a dip pen. DRAW from the references, do not preserve source image pixels or source rendering technique. Do not trace microscopic details. This is an unmistakable physical watercolor painting with loose broken pigment edges and rough freehand linework. The camera and major geometric shapes/three figures remain exact, but all containers, rails, machinery and clothing become economical painterly shapes with a few sketchy lines.
Palette restricted to charcoal-black diluted ink, burnt sepia, dirty ivory gray paper, a tiny rusty ochre glimmer from existing lamps. Almost monochrome. Negative space creates the diagonal walking paths and slender highlights on rail edges. A few bold imperfect ink outlines help readable objects, with ink feathering naturally into wet wash. Dark mournful illustrated civicspace, intimate and weathered. Less realistic, more expressive than image2, dark values but no horror. Avoid full monochrome woodcut hatching; loose transparent pools and brushmarks remain primary.
Specifically remove most small bolts, repetitive container ridges and realistic reflected gradients. No smooth3D surfaces or pasted paper texture overlay.
